author: D. H. Klein
title: Pablo Castro earns sixth straight CCIW Golfer of the Week honor for Illinois Wesleyan
text:
Illinois Wesleyan University men’s golf team sophomore Pablo Castro received his third career College Conference of Illinois and Wisconsin (CCIW) Golfer of the Week award, according to an April 8 announcement from the league office.
This recognition marks the sixth consecutive weekly honor for Illinois Wesleyan Titans Men’s Golf, which competes in NCAA Division III athletics according to the official website. The team operates from Bloomington, Illinois and is affiliated with both Illinois Wesleyan University and the College Conference of Illinois and Wisconsin.
Castro secured his first career win at the IWU Invite held April 3-4. He led a field of 255 players, helping guide the Titans to their second victory this season. Despite very wet conditions at Ironwood Golf Course—a dedicated facility for the program—Castro posted a four-under-par score of 68 on day one. On day two at Weibring Golf Course, he recorded a one-over-par round of 72, finishing tied for medalist honors with a total score of three-under-par (140). His performance contributed to a 14-stroke win over Nebraska Wesleyan.
The program participates in intercollegiate athletics at the NCAA Division III level within its conference according to the official website. It belongs to intercollegiate sports programs as reported by the official website.
Illinois Wesleyan will return to action at the Cochran Collegiate hosted by Colonial Country Club in Memphis on April 13-14.
